mechanism: Nalmefene is an opioid antagonist that may precipitate acute withdrawal in opioid-dependent patients and can potentiate CNS depression when combined with benzodiazepines like alprazolam through additive effects on GABA-ergic and opioidergic pathways.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use with extreme caution; if co-administration is necessary, monitor closely for excessive sedation, respiratory depression, and altered mental status; consider dose reduction of alprazolam.
